sourceNotes.referenceTitle: Gold Tulip Cat's Eye Pull Bracelet
sourceNotes.rawContent: Embrace effortless elegance with this stunning tulip floral bracelet. Crafted from 14K gold-plated copper, it features a shimmering cat's eye stone bud and crystal-accented leaves. The adjustable pull-chain design ensures a perfect fit for any wrist, making it a versatile accessory and a beautiful gift for someone special
